1. **Parse the protocol first.** Track attempt/demo caps and costs. Return exactly one permitted action per turn; for action-based benchmarks, put the required JSON on the final line and avoid surrounding text if required.

# ARC grid puzzle solving

Use this class-level skill for ARC/Continual-ARC tasks where the deliverable is an integer grid or a one-of-several-action response.

1. **Parse the protocol first.** Track attempt/demo caps and costs. Return exactly one permitted action per turn; for action-based benchmarks, put the required JSON on the final line and avoid surrounding text if required.

4. **Apply the inferred rule in explicit stages.** For line-marker patterns, identify complete horizontal/vertical lines through aligned markers, then determine whether objects touched by those lines change as a whole. - In the observed pattern, the whole crossed object changes, not just cells on the line.
